# page of site

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pageOfSite`](gmeow-pageOfSite.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pageOfSite>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

Relates a web page to the web site it belongs to — a specialisation of [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), so site membership rides the universal mereology spine. The discrete page→site→… hierarchy a breadcrumb trail walks.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:WebPage`](../classes/gmeow-WebPage.md) -> [`gmeow:WebSite`](../classes/gmeow-WebSite.md)
